title: fix(app-shell,auth,i18n): the organization form says requiring MFA needs two-factor on, and the enrollment screen names a two-factor-off deployment in the user's language (#30295)

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgEwzCoEjW7R3Z9w3U4hkBrX)_

domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbPN5UYMnBaNJPJWfG

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两步验证关着时，Setup 里编辑组织的表单在标题下直接说明「强制多因素认证」需要先开两步验证、勾上保存会被拒、去哪里开；两步验证开着时，保存成功把它打开后，提示里多一句：哪些成员要去绑定身份验证器、从什么时候起算宽限期（默认 7 天）。注册身份验证器的页面遇到 404（两步验证没开）时，显示本地化的「此部署未开启双重验证，请联系管理员在设置 → 认证中开启」，不再显示 `Two-factor enable failed (404)`。
- 为什么改：服务端半边 #30293 已经拒存并解除锁死，但界面上管理员事先看不到任何说明，被拒后只有一段英文；成员若被引到注册页，看到的是一句未翻译的 404。
- 风险与回滚：只改界面文案与两个认证调用的报错字段（多带 `status`、`code`，原 message 不变），新增 3 个翻译键、十个语言包齐全。没有服务端、元数据或权限改动。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizationMfaNotices.ts`（何时提示、何时不提示）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` 的组织表单挂接与保存成功 toast；`RemediationOverlay.tsx` 的 `enrollRefusalMessage`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/organizationMfaNotices-30295.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/RemediationOverlay.enrollUnavailable-30295.test.tsx`，预期 11/11 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Fixes #30295

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

The three Wanted items of the card, on a zh-CN console against a local `app-showcase` backend carrying #30293:

- **Before saving (item 1, first half).** While `GET /api/v1/auth/config` answers `features.twoFactor: false`, the `sys_organization` edit form (the Console's global record-form modal in `AppContent.tsx`; the object declares no `editMode: 'page'`) shows a notice as the dialog's description: Require Multi-Factor Auth needs two-factor, a save with it ticked is refused, and how to turn two-factor on (Require multi-factor authentication in Setup → Authentication, which applies to every organization, or `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true`). The notice is judged by `organizationMfaFormNotice` in the new `organizationMfaNotices.ts`: only that object, only a form that offers `require_mfa`, and only when the flag reads `false` (an unread config says nothing).
- **The refused save (item 1, second half): already held, no change.** Measured on the before tree: the generic form shows the server's `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` text on the `require_mfa` field, not a generic failure (the `fields[]` entry #30293 sends). See Acceptance notes for its language.
- **The accepted save (item 2).** A save that turns `require_mfa` on for a row that stored it off adds a line to the saved toast (the existing `notice` slot of `toastRecordSave`): every member without an authenticator app must set one up, and is blocked from data once the MFA grace period ends (7 days unless changed in Setup → Authentication), counted from their first use after the change; members already enrolled are not affected. The stored value comes from one `findOne` when the organization form opens (`useStoredRequireMfa`, keyed on the object, the record id and the open flag); a create counts as off, an unread value as off, a row already on says nothing.
- **The enrollment screen (item 3).** `enrollTotp` / `verifyTotp` in `@object-ui/auth` now reject with the HTTP `status` and the server's `code` beside the unchanged message (`twoFactorEnrollError`). The authenticator step of `RemediationOverlay` reads `404` (the `/two-factor/*` endpoints are mounted only while two-factor is on) as `auth.remediation.mfa.unavailable`, saying enrollment is off and that an administrator turns it on in Setup → Authentication, and `INVALID_PASSWORD` as the password screen's existing sentence. Any other refusal keeps the server's message.
- **i18n (the widening).** Three new keys in all ten packs: `auth.remediation.mfa.unavailable`, `console.organizationMfa.needsTwoFactor`, `console.organizationMfa.nowRequired`.
- Changeset `.changeset/30295-org-mfa-notice-and-enroll-refusal.md` (`patch` for `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/i18n`).

## Why

#30293 made the server refuse `require_mfa = true` while two-factor is off and stopped the gate from holding anyone it cannot enroll. Nothing in the console said so: the form offered the checkbox with the object's help ("When true, every member … must enroll"), the administrator learned the dependency only from the refusal, a successful save said nothing about who is now held or when, and a member sent to enroll on a deployment without two-factor read `Two-factor enable failed (404)`.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/organizationMfaNotices-30295.test.tsx` (new, 7): the notice's three conditions (two-factor off; on or unread; another object or no field), the saved line's (turned on; already on, left off, another object; unread counts as off), and the stored-value hook (one read per open edit, create is off, closed form or another object reads nothing, a failed read stays unread).
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/RemediationOverlay.enrollUnavailable-30295.test.tsx` (new, 4): zh and en 404 sentences (and the English `failed (404)` gone), zh `INVALID_PASSWORD`, and a control where a 429 keeps the server's message. The other RemediationOverlay files each carry their own `useAuth` mock and no shared harness exists, so this is its own file.
- `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/createAuthClient.test.ts`: a new top-level describe in the existing harness, three pins through the real better-auth client and a mocked fetch (404 on enable and on verify carries `status`, a wrong password carries `code` and `status`, messages unchanged).
- **Ablations** with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restore proven blob == HEAD (these suites import source, so no build sits between mutation and run). A, C and D ran on `c4ec9241`; B ran on `c4ec9241` and again on `9fb2f487`, after its pins moved into the harness file (3 red of 37):
  - A, the overlay's 404 branch deleted: 2 red (both 404 sentences).
  - B, `status` no longer copied onto the error: 3 red (`expected undefined to be 404`).
  - C, the notice's two-factor check deleted: 1 red (`expected 'console.organizationMfa.needsTwoFactor' to be undefined`).
  - D, the already-on check deleted: 1 red (`expected 'console.organizationMfa.nowRequired' to be undefined`).

## Acceptance notes

- **The refusal under the field is the server's English.** In a zh-CN session the field shows #30293's English message (it names `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR` and `auth.mfa_required`). It is server-authored text; this PR adds the localized notice above it rather than replacing it. Localizing that refusal belongs to the server's message.
- **The grace period's number is the default.** The console has no read of `auth.mfa_grace_period_days` (`/api/v1/auth/config` does not publish it, `@objectstack/client` has no settings read, and the settings page is admin-only), so the saved line says "7 days unless changed in Setup → Authentication". The server knows the configured value; a write notice from the server would carry it.
- **The page-mode host is not wired.** `RecordFormPage` would show neither line for an organization; `sys_organization` declares no `editMode: 'page'`, so the modal is the only host a user reaches today.
- The object's field help (`packages/platform-objects`, server metadata) still says only "When true, every member … must enroll"; this PR leaves it alone (out of this card's file surface).
- Two names for two switches: the field is 强制多因素认证 (`sys_organization.require_mfa`, every member of one organization) and the setting is 要求多因素认证 (`auth.mfa_required`, every organization, and it turns two-factor on). The notice names both in each pack's own spelling.

## Verification

Suites, type-check and gates ran on `30cfab99` (main `9afcd6a6`, which carries #30293, plus this branch); the final head `fc268ce2` merges `main` again (no `ui/` file moved) and re-ran the scoped suites.

<details><summary>Browser check (zh-CN, local app-showcase backend, Playwright)</summary>

The screenshots are in the project files (`ui-seat3/30295/`); no image host is reachable from this session. What each shows:

- `before-enroll.png` / `after-enroll.png`: the MFA overlay raised by answering one data read with the server's `403 MFA_REQUIRED` (two-factor is off, so the real gate no longer holds anyone), then the password step against the real backend, whose `POST /two-factor/enable` answered 404. Before: `Two-factor enable failed (404)`. After: 此部署未开启双重验证，暂时无法绑定身份验证器。请联系管理员在“设置 → 认证”中开启后再试。
- `before-form.png` / `after-form.png`: the 编辑组织 dialog with two-factor off. Before: no notice. After: the notice under the title.
- `before-saved.png` / `after-saved.png`: the box ticked and 更新 pressed with two-factor off. Both show the server's refusal on the field; the row stays `require_mfa: false` (read back over REST).
- `after-2fa-saved.png`: backend restarted with `OS_AUTH_TWO_FACTOR=true`, the box ticked and saved: the toast reads 组织“Default Organization”已更新 plus 本组织所有尚未绑定身份验证器的成员现在都必须绑定。每位成员从此次变更后第一次使用起开始计算 MFA 宽限期（默认 7 天，可在“设置 → 认证”中修改）… The row reads `require_mfa: true`.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites and type-check (under scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run` over the three changed test files plus the files importing the changed modules' behaviour (the five other `RemediationOverlay.*` files, `changePassword-code-27869`, and the i18n parity files `all-locales-key-parity`, `authRemediation-locale-parity`, `en-zh-key-parity`, `console-namespace-3546`): 14 files, 158 tests passed (the auth pins then moved into `createAuthClient.test.ts`: 37/37).
- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell --filter=@object-ui/auth --filter=@object-ui/i18n --concurrency=2`: Tasks 70 successful, 70 total. VERDICT command-exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `30cfab99`: 35 derived, each run with its exit code captured before any pipe: 35 exit 0 (`check:type-check-debt` under the lock). `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exit 0. `--ran` over the record (`COMMAND :: exit N`): 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0 ("a DERIVED zero — all 35 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3"). The merge of `main` (`fc268ce2`) brought no file under `ui/` or `.changeset/`; the derivation on the merged head is byte-identical, and the scoped suites re-ran green there (13 files, 158 tests). `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
</details>
